question: Find the value of sqrt{385 + sqrt{{213} + sqrt{144}}}.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve the **nested square roots** from the **innermost** to the **outermost** part.

√144 = 12

√(213 + 12) = √225 = 15

√(385 + 15) = √400 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Expression = sqrt{385 + sqrt{{213} + sqrt{144}}}

**Step-by-step calculation:**

⇒ Solve innermost root: √144 = 12

⇒ Substitute value: sqrt{385 + sqrt{213 + 12}}

⇒ Simplify middle root: √(213 + 12) = √225

⇒ Value of √225 = 15

⇒ Substitute value: √(385 + 15)

⇒ Final root calculation: √400

⇒ Result = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perfect Squares

It is helpful to memorize squares up to 30: 12² = 144, 15² = 225, 20² = 400.

BODMAS in Roots

Always simplify the **innermost vinculum** or bracket first in **nested radical** expressions.</p
